info.title: Elixir JSON API
info.description: The versioned JSON API, Elixir's public product beside MCP. Two kinds of caller: an integration by its integration_api key, and a person by an OAuth grant whose audience is https://elixir.poapkings.com/api/v1. An MCP token is refused here, and a token for this API is refused at MCP. Each operation names the callers it admits (x-principals; none named means integration). Supplied tags are unverified. Attested facts (2.2.0) are what a person did in a clan through a family app, or what a family app's own game produced for a player: kept apart from the game record, which only collectors write, and labelled with who attested them. Collection grants allow additions only. This material is unofficial and is not endorsed by Supercell. For more information see Supercell's Fan Content Policy: www.supercell.com/fan-content-policy.

integrationKey.description: An integration_api audience key; MCP and OAuth tokens are refused.

personOAuth.description: A person's OAuth 2.1 grant (PKCE) with resource https://elixir.poapkings.com/api/v1 and scope cr:read. Clients registered only with the family's own redirect origins are first-party and are not metered; other clients are limited per person per hour.

scopes.cr:read: Read the record as the signed-in person
scopes.recordings:write: Track players as the signed-in person
scopes.account:email: The account's address, family apps only
scopes.clans:attest: Record what the person does in their clan as attested facts, family apps only

code.description: The closed error code: the integration codes (unauthenticated, insufficient_scope, not_found, bad_request, invalid_json, rate_limited, daily_quota_exceeded, refresh_quota_exceeded; on the fact writes: invalid_fact, unknown_fact_type, family_apps_only, not_in_clan, not_permitted, ref_conflict) and, on a person operation, the tool's own (not_recorded, no_subject, invalid_tag, not_entitled, query_timeout, live_pending, internal).

hint.description: What to do next, when the refusal has one (person operations carry the tool's hint).

retry_after_s.description: Seconds to wait before retrying, on throttling and temporary failures (the Retry-After header carries the same).

principal.description: The same block MCP initialize carries in _meta: kind, subject (the primary player) and clan.

email.description: The account's address, present only for an Elixir family app (every redirect on a family origin) whose grant holds account:email (2.1.0).

AttestedFact.description: An attested fact as Elixir holds it. The type fixes the subject, who may attest it and who may see it (visibility: clan = anyone whose verified player is in the clan; leaders = a person whose verified player leads it, never an agent or mail; player = whoever has the player on their timeline).

ref.description: The app's own id for the fact.

created.description: true when this write made the fact (201); false when it replaced the app's earlier word for the same ref (200).

ref.description: The app's own id for the fact: a retry with the same ref is the same fact, and a new detail for it replaces the old (the attester's newer word).

player_tag.description: The member the fact is about; required for departure_classified, role_change_made, award_granted and member_away.

occurred_at.description: When it happened (default now); at most an hour ahead and a year behind.

detail.description: The type's detail, nothing else: departure_classified {kind: kick|leave, left_at?}; role_change_made {from, to} (member, elder, coLeader, leader); award_granted {award (60), season_id, place?}; member_away {until? instant or null}; clan_message {channel: leader_message|clan_chat, title? (24), body (200)}; personal_record {game (40), score, previous_best?}.
